description: This file defines the SalesOrder class extending CRMEntity, including methods for managing sales order data, related activities, history, invoices, status history, report queries, and relationships within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: SalesOrder
classes.description: Represents a sales order entity with methods for CRUD operations, related data retrieval, and relationship management within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: SalesOrder
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves the sales order module, updates quote status, saves product details, and updates currency info.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities related to the sales order.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves activity history for the sales order.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Retrieves invoices associated with the sales order.

methods.name: get_sostatushistory
methods.description: Fetches status change history of the sales order.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary report query for related modules.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationship between sales order and other entities.

methods.name: getJoinClause
methods.description: Returns join clause for specific related tables.
